aiReviews.claim: Clerk ID must be numeric and must not exceed 10 bytes.
Clerk ID: Variable up to 10 digits identifying clerk's identification number.

sourceEvidence.quote: 3 18 Clerk ID 10 C Identifies the clerk’s Identification Number.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: Segment 103 field 3 / Element 18 is conditional (C); this format claim does not itself establish the trigger for presence.

sourceEvidence.quote: Number: 18 Name: Clerk ID Character Type: N Maximum Length: 10 bytes
sourceEvidence.interpretation: Element 18 is numeric with a maximum length of ten bytes.

sourceEvidence.quote: Representation: Variable amount of up to 10 digits
sourceEvidence.interpretation: The representation is variable-length, up to ten digits.
The valid-value range begins at one; a ten-digit zero string is not a valid boundary value.

sourceEvidence.quote: Note: The Clerk ID is an optional receipt requirement.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: Receipt optionality does not decide whether Segment 103 Element 18 is present in a transaction request.

sourceEvidence.quote: When identifying a Clerk ID for ECA/ TeleCheck® processing, please refer to Data Element No. 131, ECA/ TeleCheck® Clerk ID.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: ECA/TeleCheck Element 131 is distinct from Segment 103 Element 18; values are not interchangeable. The AI cases that contain both are assessed as separate fields.

sourceAssessment.assessment: Both AI statements align with Element 18's numeric/ten-digit format when populated. They omit the fixed-vs-variable detail and conditional Segment 103 applicability; the format claim alone is not a presence rule.

exactSegment103Element18Records.title: Clerk ID, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 10
